summary: Full end-to-end test of new multi-page checkout flow (Cart -> /checkout -> /payment -> success). All 10 acceptance criteria pass. Added product from PDP, opened cart, navigated to /checkout (drawer closed correctly), verified empty-cart state, order summary + grand total, pincode auto-fill via India Post API (440001 -> Nagpur/Maharashtra, 560001 -> Bangalore/Karnataka), state dropdown with all 36 states/UTs, validation on continue button, navigation to /payment, all 5 payment methods, active-state toggle, demo note, Pay button -> processing -> success screen with order number, cart cleared to 0, Continue shopping returns home, route guards work, and site-footer / nav render on both pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: India Post API returns City='Bangalore' for 560001 (not 'Bengaluru Urban' as suggested in spec) — this is upstream data from api.postalpincode.in, not a code bug. State is correct.

Minor: /payment guard with empty cart redirects to '/' (home), not '/checkout'. Spec says 'redirects appropriately' — acceptable but /checkout might be more user-friendly (which itself will show empty state).
Nit: Payment.jsx uses window.scrollTo inside setTimeout — could use useEffect on order state for cleaner React idiom.

Nit: placeOrder in CartContext doesn't include address.lastName / state / pincode in the order object — if the future Razorpay integration needs full shipping address for the API payload, expand the order object.
seed_data_creation: None — used localStorage for cart. Test added kaju-katli via PDP.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Checkout multi-page flow fully working. When real Razorpay key is wired in Payment.jsx, retest pay() flow — placeOrder currently just simulates via setTimeout 1500ms and calls context.placeOrder(method). Ensure order object gets full address fields before sending to a real backend order endpoint.
